A group of friendly, anthropomorphic animal characters—a bear, a rabbit, and an owl—are gathered on a patchwork blanket in a lush, stylized forest glade. They are listening intently to an old, stylized tree character with a friendly face, who appears to be telling a story. The entire image has a soft, warm paper texture, gentle brush strokes, and clear, transparent colors. - Panel 3 (Position: Bottom-Left): Stern broker Mansuk accuses Saebom at the temple gate while early market vendors gather in a suspicious circle around the frightened child.
- Panel 4 (Position: Bottom-Right): Saebom kneels beside temple stones, turning the bell toward dawn and tracing its worn inner engraving with a careful trembling finger.
